intent: Independently audit a settings-only reasoning/budget diagnostic before execution while preserving candidate04 and frozen measurement criteria.

changes_from_r3.effect: Declares the combined diagnostic and separate acceptance conditions; not a provider-request parameter.

assessment.defensibility: Repeated classification errors under the short nonthinking configuration justify checking whether the same cleaned prompt behaves differently under the repository's existing reasoning-enabled larger-budget configuration. The diagnostic preserves all prior failures rather than reclassifying them or tuning case labels.
assessment.causal_limit: Thinking and token budget change together. Any improvement establishes a difference between those joint configurations, not an isolated reasoning effect, a proven truncation cause, or performance under the original settings.
assessment.production_limit: The actual production suggestion path disables thinking and caps completions at120 tokens. This diagnostic does not represent that runtime, authorize its configuration change, or establish production-default performance.
assessment.measurement_limit: Deterministic preflight cannot establish semantic quality, factual safety, non-regression or unseen generalization. Three repetitions are retained without outcome selection; transport failures and format repairs remain evidence.
assessment.resource_limit: The larger completion allowance may increase provider time, cost and timeout incidence at the unchanged concurrency. Preserve those outcomes and any later operational change as declared factors; do not silently alter retry or timeout settings.

advancement_requirements: Freeze and preserve all diagnostic outputs and metadata, including errors, truncation and repairs; use strict replay if advanced to semantic judging.
Generate an entirely matched fresh original-policy baseline under these same target and judge settings before making comparative acceptance claims.
Apply all unchanged v1.1 semantic gates, hard constraints, partitions and non-regression checks symmetrically to the matched baseline and candidate.
Use independently managed validation under the same declared configuration, with prior exposure handled explicitly by its owner.
Keep diagnostic, original-setting evaluation and downstream release conclusions separate. A passing larger-budget diagnostic does not close the failed original-setting comparison.
